trees.title: Bronze Skin
trees.identity: Take pain, make momentum. Build around impacts, Bronze equipment, or instinct.

nodes.name: Puberty
nodes.effect: +15 Strength (rite of passage).
nodes.payoff: Marks the Mace path; baseline power before tag engines.

nodes.name: Bronze Skin
nodes.effect: The first time you take damage each fight, gain 2 Harden.
nodes.payoff: Turns incoming damage into a delayed offensive opening.

nodes.name: Level 1 - Barbarian
nodes.effect: Bone, Steel, and Damascus tags now count as a Barbarian tag.
nodes.payoff: Class materials become the stacking currency.

nodes.name: Blood Market
nodes.effect: Increase Barbarian-tag item generation by 50%.
nodes.payoff: Loot bias toward your material/class tags.

nodes.name: First Bronze Age
nodes.effect: Combo slot 1 gains +8% damage per equipped Barbarian item.
nodes.payoff: Material tags and strip position become build choices.

nodes.name: Gut Instinct
nodes.effect: Every 5 effective INT contributes +1 effective STR to Mace actions.
nodes.payoff: Opens INT gear and Wizard investment to physical builds.

nodes.name: Crushing Lesson
nodes.effect: Mace weapons gain action: BLUDGEON.
nodes.payoff: Weapon kit expands; Bludgeon becomes an Impact hinge.

nodes.name: Opening Blow
nodes.effect: First Mace hit each fight applies Armor Break.
nodes.payoff: Guarantees an Impact setup every fight.

nodes.name: Level 2 - Barbarian
nodes.effect: Add the natural dice roll to your armor for next turn.
nodes.payoff: Aggressive rolls still buy defense.

nodes.name: Scrap Prefer
nodes.effect: Battle Scarred / Worn / Broken pieces: +10% Barbarian damage.
nodes.payoff: Ugly quality becomes desirable loot.

nodes.name: Level 3 - Barbarian
nodes.effect: Mace: +3% damage for each Barbarian tag.
nodes.payoff: Tag count on the swing is direct DPS.

nodes.name: Concussive Crit
nodes.effect: Crit with a Mace: apply Stun for 1 turn.
nodes.payoff: Crits buy control, not only damage.

nodes.name: Reckless Connect
nodes.effect: On MISS with a Mace roll: HIT, but take roll value as self-damage.
nodes.payoff: Accuracy through pain; feeds Pain Memory.

nodes.name: Mighty Swing
nodes.effect: Gain +35% damage per skipped or disabled slot passed, per combo.
nodes.payoff: Routing mutations become a deliberate wind-up.

nodes.name: Level 4 - Barbarian
nodes.effect: +25 STR for each empty action slot.
nodes.payoff: Short strips hit harder; rewards strip discipline.

nodes.name: Break Tempo
nodes.effect: Mace attack speed +X% per Armor Break stack on the foe.
nodes.payoff: Setup status becomes cadence.

nodes.name: Blood Crit
nodes.effect: Barbarian-tagged crits apply Armor Break.
nodes.payoff: Tag crits refresh the Impact loop.

nodes.name: Mace Mastery
nodes.effect: Bludgeon hits against Armor-Broken enemies bank +25% damage onto the next strip slot.
nodes.payoff: Rewards sequencing Armor Break before a payoff action.

nodes.name: Pain Memory
nodes.effect: Store 25% of post-armor damage taken. Your next Finisher adds it, capped at 20% max HP.
nodes.payoff: Healing, armor, speed, and finisher timing share one risk window.

nodes.name: Trophy Heal
nodes.effect: Heal X HP per Barbarian tag on kill.
nodes.payoff: Tag stacking pays sustain on clears.

nodes.name: Heavy Cadence
nodes.effect: Combo threshold −1 per 2 Barbarian tags.
nodes.payoff: Tag-dense actions enter combo more often.

nodes.name: Bone Crown
nodes.effect: Head Bone: crit Barbarian actions apply Stun.
nodes.payoff: Slot+material care (head Bone matters).

nodes.name: Scar Tissue
nodes.effect: ONTAKEHIT → Harden/Fortify from gear procs count at +1 stack while Mace equipped.
nodes.payoff: Take-hit triggers become class-valued.

nodes.name: Finisher Brand
nodes.effect: Finisher actions gain +10% damage per Barbarian tag.
nodes.payoff: Strip end is the tag payoff.

nodes.name: Blood Excess
nodes.effect: Overkill damage converts to healing.
nodes.payoff: Push kills without wasting damage.

nodes.name: Tribal Stamp
nodes.effect: Equipped Mace: all granted actions gain Barbarian if missing.
nodes.payoff: Weapon forces the tag economy onto kit.

nodes.name: Slam Doctrine
nodes.effect: On SLAM, add Barbarian tag to every equipped action (fight-scoped).
nodes.payoff: Basic refreshes the whole strip’s tag value.

nodes.name: Barbarian Rage
nodes.effect: Rage: all Barbarian-tagged actions gain Multihit +1.
nodes.payoff: Tag density × multihit burst window.

nodes.name: Living Alloy
nodes.effect: Harden and Fortify stacks count as Barbarian tags.
nodes.payoff: Defense, equipment, crits, and routing become one engine.

trees.title: Iron Discipline
trees.identity: Control the fight by converting defense and clean sequences into tempo.

nodes.name: Commission
nodes.effect: +15 Agility (rite of passage).
nodes.payoff: Marks the Sword path; baseline tempo before tag engines.

nodes.name: Iron Discipline
nodes.effect: Once per fight, a miss does not reset the strip; lose all Focus instead.
nodes.payoff: Focus doubles as accuracy and combo insurance.

nodes.name: Level 1 - Warrior
nodes.effect: Bronze, Gold, and Mithril tags now count as a Warrior tag.
nodes.payoff: Class materials become the stacking currency.

nodes.name: Muster Hall
nodes.effect: Increase Warrior-tag item generation by 50%.
nodes.payoff: Loot bias toward Bronze/Gold/Mithril.

nodes.name: First Formation
nodes.effect: Combo slot 1 gains +8% damage per equipped Warrior item.
nodes.payoff: Material count and opener placement matter.

nodes.name: Riposte
nodes.effect: After taking a hit, your next Sword action gains Pierce; if armor absorbed damage, it gains +1 hit.
nodes.payoff: Enemy attacks determine your offensive cadence.

nodes.name: Cadence Keeper
nodes.effect: Alternating actions above and below base speed grants Focus. Repeating a speed band removes one.
nodes.payoff: Mixed-speed strips outperform all-fast strips.

nodes.name: Challenge
nodes.effect: Mark and Weaken the enemy. Strip its next damage bonus and deposit it as Fortify on you.
nodes.payoff: Turns enemy buffs into defense.

nodes.name: Drill Blade
nodes.effect: Sword weapons gain action: MEASURED CUT.
nodes.payoff: Expands Sword kit around Guard/Tempo.

nodes.name: Level 2 - Warrior
nodes.effect: Add the natural dice roll to Fortify stacks for next turn (1 stack per 5 face, min 1).
nodes.payoff: Clean rolls bank defense.

nodes.name: Parade Dress
nodes.effect: Like New / Perfect / Masterwork pieces: +10% Warrior damage.
nodes.payoff: High quality is the Warrior loot fantasy.

nodes.name: Level 3 - Warrior
nodes.effect: Sword: +3% damage for each Warrior tag.
nodes.payoff: Tag count on the swing is direct DPS.

nodes.name: Shield Geometry
nodes.effect: When armor reduces a hit to zero, Expose the attacker and jump to your first Sword action.
nodes.payoff: Armor changes routing, not only effective HP.

nodes.name: Commander's Opening
nodes.effect: First normal hit lowers Combo threshold; a first-hit critical lowers Crit threshold instead.
nodes.payoff: The opening roll selects the fight plan.

nodes.name: Clean Recover
nodes.effect: On MISS with a Sword: gain Focus instead of strip reset (once/fight; stacks with root).
nodes.payoff: Misses feed the Focus economy.

nodes.name: Level 4 - Warrior
nodes.effect: +25 AGI for each filled consecutive strip slot from opener (streak bonus).
nodes.payoff: Rewards complete, unbroken lines.

nodes.name: Mobile Bulwark
nodes.effect: Each Fortify stack gives the next action -3% speed, then expires.
nodes.payoff: Choose when to cash defense into tempo.

nodes.name: Line Crit
nodes.effect: Warrior-tagged crits apply Expose.
nodes.payoff: Tag crits open Sword Mastery routing.

nodes.name: Sword Mastery
nodes.effect: Sword hits against Exposed enemies advance two slots; against Marked enemies, advance zero.
nodes.payoff: Status choice accelerates or holds the strip.

nodes.name: Flow State
nodes.effect: Three different actions connect without a miss: gain one reroll and exploding dice on the next action.
nodes.payoff: Rewards action diversity and precise sequencing.

nodes.name: Banner Heal
nodes.effect: Heal X HP per Warrior tag when ending a combo without a miss.
nodes.payoff: Clean execution sustains runs.

nodes.name: Drill Cadence
nodes.effect: Hit threshold −1 per 2 Warrior tags.
nodes.payoff: Tag-dense actions connect more reliably.

nodes.name: Mithril Crest
nodes.effect: Head Mithril: Sword connects grant Focus.
nodes.payoff: Slot+material care.

nodes.name: Plate Doctrine
nodes.effect: ONTAKEHIT → Fortify/Harden from gear: also grant 1 Focus while Sword equipped.
nodes.payoff: Take-hit triggers valued for Warrior.

nodes.name: Finisher Salute
nodes.effect: Finisher actions gain +10% damage per Warrior tag.
nodes.payoff: Strip end is the tag payoff.

nodes.name: No Waste
nodes.effect: Overkill converts to Fortify (1 stack per X overkill).
nodes.payoff: Extra damage becomes next-guard.

nodes.name: Commissioned Blade
nodes.effect: Equipped Sword: all granted actions gain Warrior if missing.
nodes.payoff: Weapon forces tag economy onto kit.

nodes.name: Strike Doctrine
nodes.effect: On STRIKE, add Warrior tag to every equipped action (fight-scoped).
nodes.payoff: Basic refreshes strip tag value.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.effect: Ending a combo without missing heals 8% max HP and converts leftover Focus into Fortify.
nodes.payoff: Clean execution sustains long dungeons.

nodes.name: Unbroken Line
nodes.effect: Once per fight, hold a slot when the strip would reset. Reaching the Finisher from that hold retriggers the opener.
nodes.payoff: Salvage, routing, and acceleration can form a controlled loop.

trees.title: Shadowcraft
trees.identity: Build delayed payoffs from marks, status conversion, failure, and exact rolls.

nodes.name: Initiation
nodes.effect: +15 Technique (rite of passage).
nodes.payoff: Marks the Dagger path; baseline precision before tag engines.

nodes.name: Shadowcraft
nodes.effect: Your first connected Dagger action Marks the enemy. Hitting another target moves the Mark.
nodes.payoff: Target commitment becomes the core Rogue rule.

nodes.name: Level 1 - Rogue
nodes.effect: Glass, Obsidian, and Shadow tags now count as a Rogue tag.
nodes.payoff: Class materials become the stacking currency.

nodes.name: Black Market
nodes.effect: Increase Rogue-tag item generation by 50%.
nodes.payoff: Loot bias toward Glass/Obsidian/Shadow.

nodes.name: First Cut
nodes.effect: Combo slot 1 gains +8% damage per equipped Rogue item.
nodes.payoff: Material count and opener placement matter.

nodes.name: Envenomed Edge
nodes.effect: Dagger hits convert one Poison stack into two Bleed; critical hits convert two.
nodes.payoff: Trade status duration for action-triggered burst.

nodes.name: Ghost Step
nodes.effect: After a miss, gain miss salvage and skip the next strip slot on your following connect.
nodes.payoff: Failure can intentionally route around an awkward action.

nodes.name: Snake Eyes
nodes.effect: Natural 2 and 12 grant Loaded. At 2 Loaded, replace the next roll with 20.
nodes.payoff: Exact faces create a slow probability engine.

nodes.name: Hidden Blade
nodes.effect: Dagger weapons gain action: MISDIRECT.
nodes.payoff: Expands fail-forward kit.

nodes.name: Level 2 - Rogue
nodes.effect: Add the natural dice roll to Bleed intensity on next connect (Mark required).
nodes.payoff: Rolls feed DoT setup.

nodes.name: Fragile Prefer
nodes.effect: Glass / Obsidian pieces: +10% Rogue damage; Shadow pieces ease crit faces.
nodes.payoff: Brittle/dark materials are the Rogue loot fantasy.

nodes.name: Level 3 - Rogue
nodes.effect: Dagger: +3% damage for each Rogue tag.
nodes.payoff: Tag count on the swing is direct DPS.

nodes.name: Hemorrhage
nodes.effect: When Bleed ticks, apply Expose for one turn; if already Exposed, add Armor Break.
nodes.payoff: Enemy speed changes the debuff payoff window.

nodes.name: Loaded Dice
nodes.effect: Replace the next natural roll with 6, 12, or 18 based on this action's strip slot.
nodes.payoff: Strip placement controls deterministic trigger faces.

nodes.name: Soft Fail
nodes.effect: On MISS with a Dagger: apply Mark if missing, else +1 Debt.
nodes.payoff: Misses still advance the Rogue engine.

nodes.name: Level 4 - Rogue
nodes.effect: +25 TEC for each distinct action tag on your strip.
nodes.payoff: Diversity (Technical Debt fuel) is raw power.

nodes.name: Bleed Tempo
nodes.effect: Dagger attack speed +X% per DoT type on the Mark.
nodes.payoff: Mixed DoTs buy cadence.

nodes.name: Quiet Crit
nodes.effect: Rogue-tagged crits apply Expose (or move Mark if already Exposed).
nodes.payoff: Tag crits refresh target lock.

nodes.name: Dagger Mastery
nodes.effect: Only the final multihit applies status, but it applies once per prior hit.
nodes.payoff: Multihit count becomes a controlled status amplifier.

nodes.name: Technical Debt
nodes.effect: Distinct action tags add Debt. Repeating a tag cashes all Debt into Expose stacks.
nodes.payoff: Players author their own setup and cash-out cycle.

nodes.name: Toxic Ledger
nodes.effect: Each different DoT on the Mark adds +10% Finisher damage; the Finisher consumes the shortest DoT.
nodes.payoff: Curate mixtures and durations instead of one maximum stack.

nodes.name: Cut Purse
nodes.effect: Heal X HP per Rogue tag on Marked kill.
nodes.payoff: Tag stacking pays on assassinations.

nodes.name: Soft Cadence
nodes.effect: Crit threshold −1 per 2 Rogue tags (Mark required).
nodes.payoff: Tag-dense marked hits crit more.

nodes.name: Shadow Hood
nodes.effect: Head Shadow: first miss each fight is salvaged automatically.
nodes.payoff: Slot+material care.

nodes.name: Poison Kit
nodes.effect: Gear poison/bleed mods: +1 intensity while Dagger and at least one Rogue material equipped.
nodes.payoff: Status affixes become class-valued.

nodes.name: Finisher Silence
nodes.effect: Finisher actions gain +10% damage per Rogue tag (doubled if Marked).
nodes.payoff: Strip end is the tag payoff.

nodes.name: Spillover
nodes.effect: Overkill on Marked foe applies leftover as Bleed to next enemy.
nodes.payoff: Overkill becomes DoT carry.

nodes.name: Concealed Edge
nodes.effect: Equipped Dagger: all granted actions gain Rogue if missing.
nodes.payoff: Weapon forces tag economy onto kit.

nodes.name: Stab Doctrine
nodes.effect: On STAB, add Rogue tag to every equipped action (fight-scoped).
nodes.payoff: Basic refreshes strip tag value.

nodes.name: No Witnesses
nodes.effect: Killing a Marked enemy retriggers the opener and preserves one miss-salvage charge.
nodes.payoff: Room sequencing and overkill become strip planning.

nodes.name: Perfect Crime
nodes.effect: On Marked death, copy the shortest DoT and highest debuff to the next enemy; resume after the Finisher.
nodes.payoff: Status and routing persist as a room-to-room engine.

trees.title: Arcane Weave
trees.identity: Compose elemental reactions, action echoes, and probability rules.

nodes.name: Apprenticeship
nodes.effect: +15 Intelligence (rite of passage).
nodes.payoff: Marks the Wand path; baseline mind before tag engines.

nodes.name: Arcane Weave
nodes.effect: The first elemental status each fight grants Focus and +1 temporary INT. A different element refreshes it.
nodes.payoff: Element variety starts the Wizard engine.

nodes.name: Level 1 - Wizard
nodes.effect: Willow, Silver, and Crystal tags now count as a Wizard tag.
nodes.payoff: Class materials become the stacking currency.

nodes.name: Reagent Market
nodes.effect: Increase Wizard-tag item generation by 50%.
nodes.payoff: Loot bias toward Willow/Silver/Crystal.

nodes.name: First Glyph
nodes.effect: Combo slot 1 gains +8% AMP per equipped Wizard item.
nodes.payoff: Material count and opener placement matter (AMP-first).

nodes.name: Kindle
nodes.effect: Burn on a Poisoned enemy consumes one Poison to add Acid and +1 Burn.
nodes.payoff: Cross-class Poison becomes an elemental reagent.

nodes.name: Spell Memory
nodes.effect: Repeating a tag adds AMP and action length. Changing tags cashes AMP onto the new action and clears both.
nodes.payoff: Choose how long to charge repetition before pivoting.

nodes.name: Prime Theory
nodes.effect: Natural prime faces grant Theorem. At 3 Theorems, the next non-prime roll explodes.
nodes.payoff: Roll history matters without removing randomness.

nodes.name: Focus Rod
nodes.effect: Wand weapons gain action: ECHO SPELL.
nodes.payoff: Expands echo/probability kit.

nodes.name: Level 2 - Wizard
nodes.effect: Add the natural dice roll to next action's AMP (face as %).
nodes.payoff: Rolls feed spell power, not armor.

nodes.name: Pure Prefer
nodes.effect: Silver / Crystal / Perfect+ pieces: +10% Wizard AMP.
nodes.payoff: Clean/rare materials are the Wizard loot fantasy.

nodes.name: Level 3 - Wizard
nodes.effect: Wand: +3% AMP for each Wizard tag.
nodes.payoff: Tag count on the swing is spell power.

nodes.name: Thermal Shock
nodes.effect: Slow on Burning consumes both to Stun; Burn on Slowed instead adds Vulnerability.
nodes.payoff: Element order chooses control or damage.

nodes.name: Rewrite Fate
nodes.effect: Spend all Theorems. Replace the next natural roll with 5 + 5 per Theorem, capped at 20.
nodes.payoff: Probability control becomes a visible timing resource.

nodes.name: Soft Miss
nodes.effect: On MISS with a Wand: gain 1 Theorem (once per fight per miss band).
nodes.payoff: Misses still feed probability.

nodes.name: Level 4 - Wizard
nodes.effect: +25 INT for each unique element applied this fight.
nodes.payoff: Element diversity is raw power.

nodes.name: Reaction Tempo
nodes.effect: Wand attack speed +X% per active elemental status on the foe.
nodes.payoff: Reactions buy cadence.

nodes.name: Sigil Crit
nodes.effect: Wizard-tagged crits refresh Focus and +1 temporary INT.
nodes.payoff: Tag crits restart Weave.

nodes.name: Channel
nodes.effect: Bank +50% AMP and -20% speed onto the next action; if it misses, preserve half.
nodes.payoff: A risky setup can target damage, status, or a retrigger.

nodes.name: Catalyst
nodes.effect: Acid armor loss becomes Burn, Poison, or Focus according to current slot modulo 3.
nodes.payoff: Armor and strip position choose the reaction output.

nodes.name: Dungeon Analysis
nodes.effect: Record the prior room's common roll band. The first roll in another band next room gains advantage.
nodes.payoff: Observed randomness informs the next room's opening.

nodes.name: Mana Leech
nodes.effect: Heal X HP per Wizard tag on kill (or restore Focus stacks).
nodes.payoff: Tag stacking pays sustain.

nodes.name: Soft Cadence
nodes.effect: Combo threshold −1 per 2 Wizard tags.
nodes.payoff: Tag-dense spells enter combo more often.

nodes.name: Crystal Circlet
nodes.effect: Head Crystal: first CAST each fight gains advantage.
nodes.payoff: Slot+material care.

nodes.name: Reagent Affix
nodes.effect: ONCONNECT AMP/threshold gear procs: +1 effective Wizard tag while Wand equipped.
nodes.payoff: Echo/probability affixes become class-valued.

nodes.name: Finisher Equation
nodes.effect: Finisher actions gain +10% AMP per Wizard tag.
nodes.payoff: Strip end is the tag payoff.

nodes.name: Residue
nodes.effect: Overkill converts to Theorem (1 per X overkill, cap).
nodes.payoff: Extra damage banks probability.

nodes.name: Bonded Wand
nodes.effect: Equipped Wand: all granted actions gain Wizard if missing.
nodes.payoff: Weapon forces tag economy onto kit.

nodes.name: Cast Doctrine
nodes.effect: On CAST, add Wizard tag to every equipped action (fight-scoped).
nodes.payoff: Basic refreshes strip tag value.

nodes.name: Wand Mastery
nodes.effect: The Wand bonus slot copies opener tags and Finisher cadence bonuses.
nodes.payoff: The extra slot becomes a programmable bridge.

nodes.name: Grand Equation
nodes.effect: Once per combo, natural roll + strip slot = 21 retriggers the opener with current elemental statuses.
nodes.payoff: Roll math, strip construction, reactions, and echoes converge.
